title: Both selfish and prosocial actors distort their impact on others, but selfish-serving spin seems to spread
title_zh: 自私与利他行为者都会扭曲对他人的影响，但自利的扭曲似乎更易传播
abstract: From consumers buying fair-trade products to policy makers funding science, people often do not know exactly how their actions will affect others. We show that selfish and prosocial actors alike may distort their impact in self-serving ways, but selfish-serving distortions catch on more readily than prosocial-serving distortions and increase followers’ selfishness.
abstract_zh: 从消费者购买公平贸易产品到政策制定者资助科学研究，人们往往不清楚自己的行为会如何影响他人。我们表明，自私与利他行为者都可能以自利的方式扭曲自己的影响，但自利的扭曲比利他的扭曲更易传播，并增加追随者的自私程度。
